title: GRACE: Parallel Best-of-N Multi-Agent Analysis of Closed-Form Questions over Dataframes with Guardrail Selection and Adaptive Retry
abstract: arXiv:2611.20983v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM agents answer closed-form questions over a tabular dataframe by writing and executing Python, almost always as a single rollout: one interpretation, one script, one result, accepted without comparison. The few pipelines that produce several candidates reconcile them by answer-agreement voting, which needs a single comparable scalar and always returns one, even when every candidate is wrong. We present GRACE (Generative, Ranked, Adaptive Code Ensemble), a production-oriented pipeline that instead runs parallel best-of-N selection specialised to dataframe code. N agents run concurrently under a strict, machine-checkable output contract, diversified by persona hints, per-retry rotation, and a two-regime temperature schedule. translated_title: GRACE：基于护栏选择与自适应重试的、面向数据框封闭式问题的并行Best-of-N多智能体分析
translated_abstract: LLM智能体通过编写并执行Python代码来回答关于表格数据框的封闭式问题，几乎总是采用单次生成模式：一种解释、一个脚本、一个结果，不经比较便直接采纳。少数能产生多个候选答案的流水线则通过答案一致性投票来协调，这要求存在单一可比较的标量答案，并且总会返回一个答案——即使所有候选都是错误的。我们提出GRACE（Generative, Ranked, Adaptive Code Ensemble，生成式、排序式、自适应代码集成），一个面向生产的流水线，专门针对数据框代码执行并行Best-of-N选择。N个智能体在严格且机器可校验的输出契约下并发运行，并通过角色提示、每次重试的轮换机制以及双区间温度调度实现多样化。GRACE不采用投票，而是评判实际执行的产物：一个两两对决的锦标赛先对候选池进行预筛，随后由领域专用护栏要么选出最佳候选，要么在没有任何可辩护候选时拒绝整个候选池。
tldr: GRACE提出一种面向生产的并行Best-of-N多智能体流水线，不依赖答案投票，而是通过两两锦标赛预筛与领域专用护栏评判实际执行的代码产物，在无可辩护答案时敢于整体拒绝，从而更可靠地回答数据框上的封闭式问题。
en_tdlr: GRACE is a production-oriented parallel best-of-N multi-agent pipeline that, instead of answer-agreement voting, judges executed code artifacts via pairwise tournament pre-filtering and a domain-specialized guardrail, selecting the best candidate or rejecting the entire pool when none is defensible for closed-form dataframe questions.
